ClientResponses.Response:
We greatly appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback regarding the Spirit E-210 grill. We are so sorry to learn you are seeing rust on the control panel. We are happy to help you with this. 

If your grill is located in a coastal or humid area, or if chlorine is present in your environment, additional maintenance will be needed to keep up the appearance of the exterior steel parts. Below are a couple helpful tips.
 
1. At the first sign of staining/discoloration/surface rust we would recommend cleaning with stainless steel cleaner. Once cleaned, we recommend using a stainless steel polish (ex. Weber's brand) to keep it looking its best in-between cleanings.
 
2. Once a week we would recommend wiping down the grill with a wet towel or rag and then drying completely.
 
3. We would only recommend covering your grill if you know inclement weather is coming.
 
4. The quicker you get at a stain the easier it will be to clean off.

Please be on the look out for an email from us. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: As one who grills often, I love this grill. I especially appreciate how compact it is (eg the sides flip down for even more space to store), but the amount of grilling space is surprisingly large. Also love the propane tank scale to monitor propane level in the tank. But mostly, the way it grills - with less flare up, and even heating.  And the app provides quick reference on how to grill different cuts of meat - or vegees and fruit. It's easy to start and easy to clean. Overall, I love the simplicity of this grill. Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill in 2016 and it has always been ready to go all year.   The one issue I have is rust on the lower tray that eventually caused the door and wheels to fail.  The rest of the grill held together really well.  I keep the grill covered for the most part and it is under a small over hang.  In all the time I have had it, there were no other issues so I will likely buy it again (I can reuse my grates and covers).   I am hesitant to upgrade to a three burner if it will have the same issues.  I will be watching the lower area closer and will apply rust preventive as needed.  This should get me a little more life out of the grill.  Other than this issue it has been a great grill.
Results.Title: Great grill but beware of rust…
